title: Swiss Franc weakens as US Dollar gains on Fed rate hike odds
summary: USD/CHF extends its winning streak for the fourth consecutive day, trading around 0.8180 during Asian hours on Monday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains support amid aggressive Federal Reserve (Fed) rate-hike bets for Wednesday’s decision following hotter US inflation reports.

title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Holds steady near 110.00, bearish technicals persist
summary: The AUD/JPY cross trades on a flat note near 110.10 during the early European trading hours on Monday.

title: Gold flat lines above $4,300 as firmer USD caps upside amid hawkish central bank bets
summary: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on Friday's modest bounce from sub-$4,300 levels and oscillates in a narrow band at the start of a new week as traders await key central bank events before placing fresh directional bets.
